routing_trace.semantics: token-major, layer-major, top-k order; logical object id = layer * 8 + expert

policy.name: DETERMINISTIC_LRU_EMPTY_INITIAL_CACHE
policy.capacity_alignment: floor(256 * requested_fraction) to whole immutable expert objects
policy.miss: issue one actual 352,321,536-byte H2D service operation before actual FusedMoE compute
policy.eviction: least-recently-used immutable discard with zero D2H writeback
policy.control_100: all 256 objects logically resident; no demand H2D
policy.host_snapshot_setup: one representative exact actual expert object; excluded from demand H2D

validation_gate: dispatch preflight clear and no foreign compute/serving process
routing trace hash, shape, demand count and full 256-object coverage exact
capacity and resident bytes never exceed the whole-object budget
every logical miss maps to one actual object-sized H2D service operation
all H2D completes before actual FusedMoE compute
zero D2H writeback and exact load/hit/eviction/byte conservation
final output and routed-expert array equal the clean frozen control
raw local backup and SHA-256 verification before promotion
held_out_rule: Held-out point raw execution and interpretation remain locked until all fit points plus 100% control are reviewed without changing policy, capacity alignment, trace, thresholds or claim boundary.
adaptive_refinement_rule: No refinement is dispatched until fit plus held-out results are frozen; any trigger must add new child IDs and may not replace required anchors.
claim_boundary: Compute-integrated GPU policy replay with actual object-sized H2D service and actual FusedMoE compute. Not runtime-native expert residency, not physical movement of every logical object, and not an end-to-end speedup or hardware break-even claim.
